note: Triennial election of Banbridge Rural District Council, 1955 (Co. Down county and rural poll day Thursday 2 June 1955). Nomination day was Tuesday 17 May 1955; there was no contest in any division (Banbridge Chronicle, 21 May 1955, p. 5). The returning officer's notice of result, dated 2 June 1955, lists sixteen candidates elected unopposed and, in the four divisions with no nomination (Annaclone, Ballybrick, Leitrim and Loughans), the retiring councillors deemed to be re-elected (Banbridge Chronicle, 4 June 1955, p. 8). No party labels were printed. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
